title: For those of you wondering what’s up with some of this apparently unrelated music stuff… I’m working on a way of authenticating real people in the community… at the moment live music still seems to be safe from ai/chat-bots.
content: I’m hoping this can serve as a kind of verification process over on the discord. Also I think it can function as a kind of framework for developing ideas that are too ineffable by their nature to communicate purely with text.
